name: com.alaabuhadbeh.teethviewer
description: A modular, project-agnostic 3D treatment viewer: staged tooth-movement playback, tooth selection and constrained manipulation, and a URP tooth shader. Domain logic is pure C# and fully unit-tested; presentation is a thin MonoBehaviour layer.

samples.description: A ready-to-play scene: a full 32-tooth arch playing a sample staged treatment, with the on-screen controls overlay.
